Your first class

Wear comfortable clothes, bring water, and arrive with an open mind. Mat availability and studio directions will be confirmed with the timetable.

A few things to know

Start with
a little curiosity.

Do I need to be flexible?

No. Choose a comfortable range of movement, and use variations that work for you. Yoga is a practice you can explore at your own pace.

Which class should I start with?

Our Hatha and Restorative descriptions offer a gentle starting point. Once our teachers and timetable are available, we can help you choose a class.

When will the schedule be available?

The class timetable and booking details will be added here soon.
